LESSON: SIGN READING 11.4.1 GRADE - APPROPRIATE PLAY: LESSONS LEARNT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Sign Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How are different issues addressed in the play?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking: interpretation and inference skills when learners read different excerpts of a play and elicit lessons learnt.

• Collaboration: teamwork skill when learners analyse the lessons elicited by pairs and relate them to real life experiences.

Values:
Responsibility: the learner takes up the role allocated to dramatize a play.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate the concept of play learnt in English to acting in Creative Arts and sports.

Suggested Learning Resources

Class readers, Adapted Course books, Flash cards, Recording devices e.g. tablets and mobile phones, Dictionary, Internet,
